simple.meaning: שָׁבִיס (shâbîyç) is a Hebrew word meaning “a netting for the hair.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.summary: שָׁבִיס (shâbîyç) / H7636 is traced through Isaiah 3:18 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H7636. shabis שָׁבִיס noun [masculine] front-band (Mishna id.; Levy NHWB iv. 498 ; al. compare Arabic , literally a sun , of small glass neck-ornament We Skizzen iii. 145 ; Hebrew perhaps a diminutive, see Ges § 86 note); — plural הַשְּׁבִיסִים Isa 3:18 , in list of women's finery.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to interweave ;
